mentions.name: SnapRecaller
mentions.description: This free iOS app turns screenshots into reminders, so screenshots users take to revisit later actually resurface instead of being forgotten.
mentions.problem: People screenshot things they mean to come back to and then never look at them again.
mentions.source_excerpt: SnapRecaller, a free iOS app. I screenshot things I mean to come back to and then never look at them again. So I built this: take a screenshot and it becomes a reminder.
